sentences.en: The one resource more precious than any other was land.
sentences.zh: 比任何其他资源都更加珍贵的是土地。

sentences.en: The rocket landed sufficiently gently to avoid breaking its instruments.
sentences.zh: 火箭着陆得非常平稳，没有损坏仪器。

sentences.en: The pilot explained to us why the landing was delayed.
sentences.zh: 飞行员向我们解释了为什么推迟着陆。
